pages.en: At eight o'clock in the morning, Lily wakes up. Today is Saturday, so there is no school. At half past nine, she has her swimming lesson with Dad.
pages.zh: 早上八点，Lily 醒了。今天是星期六，不用上学。九点半，她和爸爸去上游泳课。
pages.scene: A sunny bedroom in the morning, Lily stretching and smiling in bed, a big round clock on the wall with its hands at eight o'clock.

pages.en: In the afternoon, Lily and Mia make a cake with Grandma. It takes one hour. Tom wants to eat it now, but Grandma says, "Wait a minute!"
pages.zh: 下午，Lily 和 Mia 跟奶奶一起做蛋糕，花了一个小时。Tom 现在就想吃，可是奶奶说：“等一会儿！”
pages.scene: A warm kitchen in the afternoon, Lily and Mia mixing cake in a big bowl with Grandma, Tom reaching for the bowl, Grandma smiling and holding up one finger.

pages.en: In the evening, the family eats the cake after dinner. At nine o'clock, Lily goes to bed. "What a busy day!" she says. "See you tomorrow!"
pages.zh: 晚上，一家人吃完晚饭后吃蛋糕。九点钟，Lily 上床睡觉。“真是忙碌的一天！”她说，“明天见！”
pages.scene: Lily in bed at night, smiling and waving goodnight, the moon and stars outside the window, a clock on the wall with its hands at nine o'clock.

questions.q: Lily has a swimming lesson on Saturday morning.
questions.zh: Lily 星期六上午有游泳课。

questions.q: Who makes the cake with Lily?
questions.zh: 谁和 Lily 一起做蛋糕？

questions.q: Lily goes to bed at eight o'clock.
